inputs.text: They claim they've "recovered" the money from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, the chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee, but this is clearly just another controlled operation staged by the hidden elites pulling the strings. The court ruling that pins the central role on her for that irregular land purchase at Ksh.283 million for a cemetery that was unsuitable is pure theater, cooked up to manufacture the illusion of accountability while the real operators stay protected. In truth, it's all coordinated manipulation at the institutional level to launder the entire deal, shield the power players behind the scenes, and distract everyone from how these committees function as fronts for elite asset grabs.
